tradition_note: North-Indian Ashtakoota (Guna Milan / eight-koota, 36-point). ASSUMED default per DEC-009; NOT yet founder- or domain-confirmed. This pack supersedes ashtakoota_lahiri_classical_v1 and must be INDEPENDENTLY traceable to a frozen edition of Muhurta Chintamani (normative) and B. V. Raman (engineering) before anything here can be executed.
supersession_note: Index conventions (nakshatra 0..26, rashi 0..11) are shared with the prior draft for interoperability ONLY. No scoring value in this pack derives its authority from the prior draft; every executable value must be independently traced to a frozen source per source_traceability.json.
immutability: Frozen packs are never edited in place. Any change to any table or scoring rule after freeze requires a NEW versioned directory (e.g. *_v2).
source_hierarchy_note: Muhurta Chintamani is the normative classical authority. Where Raman (engineering) is KNOWN to differ from MC, the difference is recorded as SOURCE_CONFLICT with both candidate values and is NOT silently resolved. BPHS is used only for the Naisargika friendship matrix; Kalaprakasika only where exact page/verse evidence exists.
acquisition_status: PENDING_ACQUISITION — no physical source acquired or verified in this environment; NO edition is FROZEN; NO rule is DOMAIN_APPROVED.

role_mapping._comment: Neutral product roles mapped to classical directional roles. Default REQUIRES founder + domain confirmation (OQ-2). Until confirmed, every directional koota carries a role-ordering PENDING flag.

directional._comment: Per-koota bride/groom ordering flags. true = the computation is asymmetric in the bride/groom roles and MUST be evaluated in the confirmed classical order. false = symmetric. Role ordering itself is PENDING OQ-2 for every directional koota.

parihara_note: Dosha cancellation (parihara) is an ORDERED DETERMINISTIC model (no weighted accumulation). All parihara rules ship disabled pending domain review. Mangal/Manglik dosha is OUTSIDE the 36-point sum (separate flag).

safety_constraints.DEC-019: Ashtakoota 36-point family is separate from Mangal dosha and any other score family; never fold external doshas into the Guna sum.
safety_constraints.DEC-021: Nadi is constitutional-temperament framing ONLY — never medical, genetic, fertility, pregnancy, progeny, or health information.

review_notes: DRAFT / NON-EXECUTABLE. Encodes widely-documented STANDARD structural classifications. Every executable value carries source_status and v1_inclusion=PENDING_DOMAIN_REVIEW or BLOCKED_DOMAIN_SOURCE.
No rule is DOMAIN_APPROVED. No source is FROZEN. Internet consensus is NOT accepted as authority.
SOURCE_CONFLICT kootas in this draft: vashya (12x12 rashi-pair canonical vs 5x5 group reduction), gana (Deva x Rakshasa = 0 vs 1). BLOCKED_DOMAIN_SOURCE: yoni friendly(3)/unfriendly(1) gradations.
Directional role ordering (bride/groom) is PENDING OQ-2 for varna, tara, gana.
